scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm -w apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:libs && npm -w apps/worker run dev
scripts.build:libs: npm run db:generate && npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w packages/db run build
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/worker run build
scripts.lint: npm -w apps/web run lint && npm -w apps/worker run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm -w packages/db run typecheck && npm -w packages/shared run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck && npm -w apps/worker run typecheck
